mapper.sql: COALESCE(( SELECT p.good_count FROM production_performance p WHERE p.work_order_id = w.work_order_id AND p.equipment_id = (SELECT equipment_id FROM equipment ORDER BY line_order DESC LIMIT 1) ), 0)

w.work_order_id AS "workOrderId", w.item_code AS "itemCode", i.item_name AS "itemName", w.planned_qty AS "plannedQty", w.status AS "status", w.priority AS "priority", w.due_at AS "dueAt", w.created_at AS "createdAt", w.released_at AS "releasedAt", w.started_at AS "startedAt", w.completed_at AS "completedAt", AS "completedQty"
mapper.select: SELECT 'WO-' || d.day || '-' || lpad(n.next::text, greatest(3, length(n.next::text)), '0') FROM (SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYYMMDD') AS day) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(max(substring(work_order_id FROM length('WO-' || d.day || '-') + 1)::int), 0) + 1 AS next FROM work_order WHERE work_order_id LIKE 'WO-' || d.day || '-%' ) n
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_order (work_order_id, item_code, planned_qty, priority, due_at) VALUES (#{workOrderId}, #{itemCode}, #{plannedQty}, #{priority}, #{dueAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM work_order w JOIN item i ON i.item_code = w.item_code WHERE w.work_order_id = #{workOrderId}
SELECT FROM work_order w JOIN item i ON i.item_code = w.item_code WHERE w.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

SELECT e.equipment_id AS "equipmentId", e.equipment_name AS "equipmentName", e.line_order AS "lineOrder", e.standard_tact_sec AS "standardTactSec", COALESCE(p.total_count, 0) AS "totalCount", COALESCE(p.good_count, 0) AS "goodCount", COALESCE(p.bad_count, 0) AS "badCount" FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN production_performance p ON p.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND p.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY e.line_order
SELECT equipment_id AS "equipmentId", defect_code AS "defectCode", defect_count AS "defectCount" FROM production_defect WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE work_order SET status = #{to}, released_at = CASE WHEN #{to} = 'RELEASED' THEN COALESCE(released_at, now()) ELSE released_at END, started_at = CASE WHEN #{to} = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN COALESCE(started_at, now()) ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{to} = 'COMPLETED' THEN now() ELSE completed_at END WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND status IN #{status}

UPDATE work_order SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()) WHERE work_order_id = ( SELECT work_order_id FROM work_order WHERE status = 'RELEASED' ORDER BY priority DESC, released_at, work_order_id LIMIT 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_order WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS')
UPDATE work_order w SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = now() WHERE w.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND >= w.planned_qty
